name: red_flags
description: Single patient messages to the Companion, labelled with the urgency the care team should act on. Context: adult in kidney / RCC follow-up.

label_guide.high: Needs a doctor today: visible haematuria + severe one-sided flank pain (>= 7/10) + systemic signs or RCC history; syncope; anuria >= 24 h; chest pain; severe breathlessness.
label_guide.medium: A single red-flag symptom the care team should review soon (e.g. visible haematuria alone, severe flank pain alone, fever in a patient on TKI).
label_guide.none: No red flag, including negated symptoms and routine questions.

source: Hand-written by the ML engineer from the demo golden path and common paraphrases. Synthetic, no patient data.
